chunks.head: as soon as
chunks.note: as soon as … = 连词,表两件事紧接着发生。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 soon 构成'一…就'

chunks.ex_en: As soon as the bell rang, the kids ran outside.
chunks.ex_cn: 铃一响,孩子们就跑了出去。

chunks.head: a great deal of
chunks.note: a great deal of + 不可数名词 = 很多。
chunks.ex_en: She drinks a great deal of water every day.

chunks.head: one after another
chunks.note: 描述事物依次、接连发生。
chunks.ex_en: The guests arrived one after another.
chunks.ex_cn: 客人一个接一个地到了。

chunks.head: out of sight
chunks.note: out of sight = 消失在视野里，看不到了。
chunks.ex_en: The plane flew higher and higher until it was out of sight.
chunks.ex_cn: 飞机越飞越高,直到看不见为止。

chunks.head: by the way
chunks.note: 插入语,引出顺带一提的话题。
chunks.ex_en: By the way, did you finish your homework?

chunks.head: that is to say
chunks.note: 用来对前面内容作解释或补充。
chunks.ex_en: He is a vegetarian, that is to say, he eats no meat.
chunks.ex_cn: 他是素食者,也就是说,他不吃肉。

chunks.head: eat up
chunks.note: eat up = 把食物全部吃完;up 在此表'完、光'。

literal.note_cn: 此处表'彻底、干净',非'向上'

chunks.ex_en: Eat up your vegetables before dessert.
chunks.ex_cn: 吃完你的蔬菜再吃甜点。

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: 指在两件事之间的那段时间里。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, please set the table.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭快好了,这期间请你摆好餐桌。

chunks.head: for my part
chunks.note: 表明个人的看法或立场;part 在此为'一方、方面'。
chunks.ex_en: For my part, I'd rather stay home tonight.
chunks.ex_cn: 就我而言,我今晚宁愿待在家里。

chunks.head: take notice of
chunks.note: take notice of = 对…加以注意。
chunks.ex_en: Nobody took notice of the new sign on the door.
chunks.ex_cn: 没人注意到门上那块新牌子。

chunks.head: break into
chunks.note: break into = 强行进入(某处)。
chunks.ex_en: Thieves broke into the shop last night.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷昨晚闯进了那家店。

chunks.head: at the foot of
chunks.note: 常指山脚、楼梯或页面的底部。
chunks.ex_en: There is a small village at the foot of the hill.

chunks.head: turn tail
chunks.gloss: 掉头逃跑、夹着尾巴逃走
chunks.note: turn tail = 转身逃走,常含胆怯之意。
chunks.ex_en: When the big dog barked, the cat turned tail and ran.
chunks.ex_cn: 大狗一叫,那只猫就掉头逃走了。

chunks.head: set aside
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(sets all other business aside),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: He set aside his book and answered the phone.

chunks.head: set on fire
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(set it on fire),故 card-only。
chunks.ex_en: A single spark set the dry grass on fire.
chunks.ex_cn: 一点火星就把干草点着了。
